description: the coding agent behind toyota_mechanic: edits a sandbox copy of Toyota's source, test-first
notes: NOT routable: it is deliberately absent from extra_roles.py's EXTRA_ROLE_NAMES, because run outside adws/adw_toyota_mechanic.py it would edit live code with no sandbox, gate or rollback. Only that workflow runs it (--coder), and it replaces output_path with the run's own sandbox. Its {{task}} is the task.md the workflow writes per run. model is pinned here rather than inherited from Toyota's --role-model, as it always was (formerly a literal in finance_team/mechanic_runner.py).
